key_insights: BTC grinding at resistance makes altcoin trading tricky - three scenarios: breakout (good), pullback to $20K (dip buy opportunity), or resistance grind (worst for alts)
ETH showing weak structure at monthly range high with lower lows
Five altcoins at key inflection points with clear levels: AVAX ($21.30), GRT ($0.14-0.15), LDO ($2.60-2.70), OP ($2.30 range low), DOT ($6.87)
Approach is to use these levels for short-term trading regardless of directional bias
Optimism's response to Coinbase L2 news will reveal broader risk appetite among altcoins
summary: Cred analyzes altcoins while BTC grinds at weekly/monthly resistance, noting this is the worst of three scenarios for altcoin trading. Five altcoins (AVAX, GRT, LDO, OP, DOT) have clear technical levels for short-term trading. Overall sentiment is neutral - waiting for BTC breakout or pullback before getting aggressive with alts, but enough volatility exists for short-term trades at key inflection points.
